text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri expected in Morocco at the invitation of his counterpart Abdellatif Filali.
- Seizure of more cocaine on Moroccan coasts which could bring total to four tonnes.
- About 50 percent of Moroccan married couples do not use contraceptives.

- Portugal says it understands Morocco's refusal to renew fish accord with the European Union as stocks are dwindling but says Portuguese should look at setting up joint firms in the north Africam country.
- Tax evasion liable to punishment of upto 50,000 dirhams ($5,263) fine and, in event of repetition, a jail term of upto five years.
